summary: Frontend-only cinematic redesign verification for Circle Concentration (/exercise/expanding-circle) and Candle Flame (/exercise/candle-flame). All acceptance criteria PASSED. Regression on /exercise/flower-observation and /exercise/breath-counter also passed (default theme preserved).

circle_concentration.whole_page_pastel_gradient: PASS - exercise-player inline background = 'linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(255,233,210) 0%, rgb(247,234,217) 22%, ... rgb(222,211,228) 100%)' covering full player (including behind controls card)
circle_concentration.breath_cue_testid: PASS - data-testid='breath-cue' present, teal italic; alternates 'Breathe In' <-> 'Breathe Out' during play
circle_concentration.mandala_backdrop_testid: PASS - data-testid='circle-mandala-backdrop' present with rings, diagonals, triangles, flecks
circle_concentration.eight_orbs: PASS - circle-orb-0 through circle-orb-7 all present (count=1 each)
circle_concentration.central_sphere_with_focus_dot: PASS - circle-central-sphere renders teal/aqua sphere with dark focus dot (visible in screenshot)
circle_concentration.controls_translucent_glassy: PASS - controls card is bg-white/45 backdrop-blur, pastel gradient visible through
circle_concentration.sphere_breathes_when_playing: PASS - transform scale changed from 0.55 (paused) to 1.02822 (mid-cycle after play), cue text also switched Breathe In -> Breathe Out

candle_flame.uniform_dark_navy_background: PASS - exercise-player computed backgroundColor = rgb(11,24,48) AND inline background = 'rgb(11, 24, 48)'; candle-scene bg = rgb(11,24,48). No seam between exercise area and controls area (verified visually and via matching color values)
candle_flame.large_mandala_backdrop: PASS - candle-mandala-backdrop bounding box 820x820 vs candle 280x495 (mandala substantially bigger than candle)
candle_flame.no_baked_text_in_mandala: PASS - mandala is pure inline SVG (no <image> element, no 25:00, no 'Deep Work Sprint' text in DOM or visually)
candle_flame.candle_svg_renders: PASS - candle-svg present with wax drips, wick, animated flame group
candle_flame.controls_dark_translucent: PASS - control card bg = rgba(255,255,255,0.06) (backdrop-blur on dark navy)
candle_flame.title_light_readable: PASS - h1 color = rgb(230,236,246) (light on dark navy)
candle_flame.flame_and_sparks_animate: PASS - 18 candle-spark elements rendered; flame group has candle-flame-flicker animation when isPlaying=true

reset_and_slider.reset_button: PASS - reset button present on both exercises, timer resets correctly
reset_and_slider.duration_slider: PASS - visible on both exercises when paused

regression.flower_observation_default_theme: PASS - exercise-player inline background is empty string (default theme intact), palette-button still present
regression.breath_counter_default_theme: PASS - exercise-player inline background is empty string (default theme intact)

critical_code_review_comments: ExercisePlayer.jsx line 79-80: setDuration/setTimeRemaining initialization uses exerciseDetails[exerciseId]?.defaultDuration only on mount; navigating between different exercises in same session without unmount would carry over duration - not observed here since routes remount, non-issue in practice.

The auto-hide controls (3s) can hide the play button while user is still trying to interact - during testing the pause button ended up outside the viewport (bottom controls slide down); minor UX concern but the mousemove handler reveals them again as designed.
